secondary.manual_note: TE and Yahoo agree with each other (actual 3.9%, previous ~4.2%) on 2026-09-15 on the same ONS series ('Total Pay' == 'incl. Bonus'); our primary source's own forecast (4.5%) diverges more from TE's (4.0%) than previous does (4.3% vs 4.2%, 0.1pp) -- forecasts legitimately vary by vendor consensus panel and are not the identity signal here; `previous`, the fixed historical fact both secondary vendors independently corroborate, is.

Trading Economics' Japan 'Current Account' is the n.s.a. headline series, distinct from 'Adjusted Current Account'. Verified 2026-10-07: TE previous 2989B equals the primary feed's n.s.a. previous 2988.9B rounded to TE's whole-number display; forecasts differ by vendor consensus panel. The by-value check cannot confirm it because _parse_numeric() does not parse B-suffixed values.
